feed.title: NPR Programs: Morning Edition
feed.subtitle: Morning Edition takes listeners around the country and the world with multi-faceted stories and commentaries every weekday. Hosts Steve Inskeep, Leila Fadel, Michel Martin and A Martínez bring you the latest breaking news and features to prepare you for the day.

entry.title: FAA says it will rethink how it does upgrades after nationwide ground stop
entry.summary: The Federal Aviation Administration says the agency will rethink how it upgrades its aging technology, days after a system upgrade brought down the nation's airspace

entry.title: Sen. Jack Reed says FAA needs a real plan, not just more money
entry.summary: Sen. Jack Reed raised concerns about FAA oversight of contractors after last week's nationwide ground stop and criticized the Trump administration's request for $50 billion in additional funding.

entry.title: Does locking up a student's cell phone improve test scores? A new study suggests so
entry.summary: A new study of school cellphone bans finds they may help students make up for some of the learning they've lost since 2013 – a divergence from earlier study results.

entry.title: Morning news brief
entry.summary: The FAA says it will rethink how it upgrades its aging system after nationwide ground stop, Trump to hold joint summit with leaders of China and Russia, Silicon Valley reacts to Nvidia scandal.

entry.title: 'Madden' chronicles John Madden's prolific career from the gridiron to video games
entry.summary: A Martinez talks to actor Christian Bale, who plays Raiders owner Al Davis in the biopic "Madden," chronicling John Madden's exit from the NFL sidelines to the broadcast booth and video game history.

entry.title: Health organization to announce that the U.S. has lost its measles elimination status
entry.summary: The Pan American Health Organization is expected to announce that measles is no longer eliminated in the U.S. Record cases, lower vaccination rates and uncontained outbreaks led to the resurgence.

entry.title: Infectious disease doctor on what Americans should know about measles in the U.S.
entry.summary: NPR's Michel Martin asks infectious disease doctor Céline Gounder what the public should know about the resurgence of measles in the U.S.

entry.title: Grammy's best new artist nominees represent a wide range of genres
entry.summary: This year's Grammy nominations for best new artist run the gamut from a breakout country singer to an experimental rock duo.

entry.title: After Democrats' midterm wins, some hope attacks on DEI will ease
entry.summary: After the midterms, a Democratic congressman declared that DEI is back. What does Democrats' ascendance portend for diversity initiatives that the Trump administration has relentlessly attacked?

entry.title: Researchers are studying how large storms spread microplastics in the environment
entry.summary: In communities struck by Hurricane Helene, researchers have a rare chance to see how big storms increase the amount of microplastics in the environment.
